## Audience

Audience matches any include subject unless any exclude subject matches.
Empty include matches everyone. Subjects are exact, case-sensitive identities;
matching a subject does not grant RBAC permissions.

_Appears in:_
- [AdmissionRule](#admissionrule)
- [AdmissionWarning](#admissionwarning)
- [RequestMatch](#requestmatch)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `exclude` _[Subject](#subject) array_ |  |  | MaxItems: 64 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |

## Target

Target selects a resource kind and labels. Admission targets support Capsule GVK
patterns and match namespaced resources only, except concrete v1 Node targets.
Scheduled actions require a concrete namespaced apiVersion and kind.

_Appears in:_
- [ChangeWindowSpec](#changewindowspec)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` _string_ |  |  | MinLength: 1 <br /> |
| `apiVersion` _string_ | APIVersion uses Capsule GVK matching: omitted/empty means core v1;<br />apps matches any apps version, apps/v1 is exact, and * matches all groups<br />and versions. Partial patterns such as apps/* and *.example.com/v1 work too. |  | MaxLength: 256 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `kind` _string_ | Kind is case-sensitive and supports * patterns, for example *Set or Deploy*. |  | MaxLength: 256 <br />MinLength: 1 <br /> |
| `selector` _[LabelSelector](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.36/#labelselector-v1-meta)_ | Selector selects resource labels. For Nodes it selects nodes directly;<br />for namespaced targets it applies within the selected namespaces. |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
